newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediolanum H1 life premiums up 32 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mediolanum H1 life premiums up 32 pct.

text.p: Italian insurance and financial services group Mediolanum SpA said first half 1996 gross life premium income rose to 518.6 billion lire from 394 billion lire in the same 1995 period.
Consolidated revenues totalled 571.2 billion lire and net profit was 43.3 billion lire, a company statement said.
There were no comparative figures as the company, jointly owned by Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest SpA and group managing director Ennio Doris, was only floated on the Milan bourse on June 3.
Group gross investment fund deposits were up five percent to 984 billion lire.
Mediolanum shares closed in Milan 1.25 percent up at 16,748 lire.
